name: What should I know about sealing marble in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I know about sealing marble in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sealing is a critical step for marble in a bathroom to protect it from stains and etching. Marble is porous and can absorb liquids, leading to discoloration. A penetrating sealer is applied to fill the pores and create a barrier without changing the marble's appearance. The initial seal should be applied immediately after installation, and re-sealing is typically recommended every 6 to 12 months, depending on usage and the type of marble and sealer. Regular testing by placing a few drops of water on the surface can help determine if it needs re-sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sealing marble is essential to protect it from stains and etching due to its porous nature. Apply a penetrating sealer upon installation and re-seal every 6-12 months, or when water no longer beads on the surface.
